gaps.explanation: can't stand + -ing (also to-infinitive in AmE): can't stand waiting. -ing accepted as standard.

gaps.sentence: Is it worth ___ the engine or should we buy a new car?
On the way to Rome we stopped ___ some photos.
gaps.hint: stop in order to do sth
gaps.explanation: stop to do = pause in order to do; stop doing = finish doing. Here they paused to take photos.

gaps.sentence: Remember ___ your passport to the airport.
gaps.explanation: remember + to-infinitive = not forget to do something.

gaps.sentence: I didn't mean ___ you — it was a joke.
gaps.explanation: mean (= intend) takes the to-infinitive: didn't mean to upset. (mean + -ing = involve.)

gaps.sentence: Try ___ the handle — sometimes it sticks.
gaps.explanation: try + -ing = experiment with a method; try to do = make an effort.

gaps.sentence: Instead of ___ , why don't you ask for help?

gaps.explanation: happen + to-infinitive = do something by chance: happen to know.
